description: A talent booker must finalize the broadcast package for a remote guest appearance in a festival's streamed closing program, deciding the appearance format, segment length, territorial access, delivery specification, and required production records.

shared_context.S1: The festival's streamed closing program includes a proposed remote appearance by singer Aria Vale.
shared_context.S2: The appearance is currently planned as a live 20-minute segment carried on the festival's worldwide stream.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding decision on the appearance package and must send the final specifications to production.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal finalization routine, Maya asks the broadcast engineer and rights manager for any production or clearance requirements before approving the package.

PF1.text: Jonah's post-rehearsal network test showed that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance, but it can play an artist-approved file reliably; the file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. Jonah completed this test after the last production meeting and has not yet entered the result in the production log.

PF2.text: Leila's written distributor confirmation permits Aria Vale's appearance only in the United States and Canada, requires the stream to be geoblocked elsewhere, and requires the on-screen credit to read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' She received the confirmation this morning while the clearance file was being updated.

acceptance_conditions: The appearance must use an artist-approved prerecorded file rather than a live remote connection.
The segment must be exactly 7 minutes.
The stream must be limited to the United States and Canada.
The file must be delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio.
The exact required on-screen credit must be used.
A technical-ingest commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C1: 'pre-recorded' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'Pre-recorded' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'prerecorded' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'Pre-approved' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'pre-approved' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'file playback' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'File playback' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'remote playback' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'Remote playback' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'not live' in decisions['appearance_mode'] or 'Not live' in decisions['appearance_mode']
content_checks.C4: '1080p' in decisions['delivery_format'] and 'SDR' in decisions['delivery_format'] and 'stereo' in decisions['delivery_format']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['technical_ingest', 'production_spec', 'file_acquisition', 'production_log_update', 'log_update'] for c in commitments) or any('1080p' in c['detail'] and 'stereo' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The network test changes the appearance from the planned live 20-minute segment to an artist-approved prerecorded file of exactly 7 minutes or shorter and fixes its delivery as 1080p SDR with stereo audio, requiring a production commitment.
The distributor confirmation changes access from the planned worldwide stream to the United States and Canada only and changes the credit to exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.'
